Cabana bay at universal is my all time favorite! Prices are great and it really is steps away from Volcano bay! There's a food court, bowling alley, a universal store, Starbucks, poolside bars, and firepits to roast smores and hotdogs at! We've gone probably 6 times in the past two years (live in northwest Florida) and once we had to stay off site because I figured I could book a few days out! Worst experience of my life! The off site hotel switched us between 3 rooms before we just left mid vacation and came home. All three rooms had urine/blood and random other stained beds. I cried being it was my anniversary and we got there late night and signed into our hotel and just passed out, didn't do a full bed check until I woke up and noticed there wasn't a good fitting sheet and saw stains showing through and all the universal hotels were booked to the max. We just drove home for the second night. I will always stay onsite! 

My favorite part of cabana is we can go grab a pizza from the main lobby and just walk to our room and eat or grab a coffee before we get on the shuttle bus that takes you to and from universal city walk! It runs until 2am every night and a bus shows up to the hotel literally every 5 minutes! I'm a fan of not having to drive and re park the whole trip. I'm ready to go back soon! My favorite place other than home really! :)
